title: 7-Day Saigon Cosmopolitan & The Bluffs Ho Tram Coastal Links
description: City glamour meets rugged coastal links. Stay at Park Hyatt Saigon and The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram, playing VGCC, Tan Son Nhat, and The Bluffs.
destination: Ho Chi Minh City & Ho Tram Coast, Vietnam

signatureTour.title: The Saigon and Shores Escape
signatureTour.highlight: Our flagship southern Vietnam tour combining Park Hyatt Saigon with The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram and private yacht sunset cruises.

inclusions.detail: Door-to-door private luxury vehicle transfers throughout Saigon and the Ho Tram coast.
4 rounds: VGCC, Tan Son Nhat, and 2 rounds at The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.
3 nights at Park Hyatt Saigon + 3 nights at InterContinental Grand Ho Tram.
One dedicated caddie and shared buggy included for every round.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City & Park Hyatt Saigon Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Metropolitan Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Park Hyatt Saigon — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Park Hyatt Saigon luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) where your private chauffeur welcomes your group and transfers you to Park Hyatt Saigon, overlooking the historic Opera House.

Sip a cocktail at 2 Lam Son lounge before dinner at Square One, celebrating contemporary Vietnamese and French culinary traditions.

itinerary.title: Championship Parkland at Vietnam Golf & Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Classic Southern Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Vietnam Golf & Country Club — Chen King Shih (West) / Lee Trevino (East) (Par 72 (West) / 72 (East), 7,106 Yards / 6,946 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Vietnam Golf & Country Club championship golf course Chen King Shih (West) / Lee Trevino (East) Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Vietnam Golf & Country Club (VGCC), playing the championship East Course designed by Lee Trevino. Flanked by mature trees and narrow landing areas, Trevino's layout demands accurate driving and precise approach play.

Return to Saigon for an afternoon swim in the tropical garden pool at Park Hyatt, followed by rooftop drinks overlooking the city skyline.

itinerary.title: High-Tech Modern Golf at Tan Son Nhat Golf Course
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Modern Urban Championship Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course — Nelson & Haworth (Par 71 / 72 (two courses), 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course championship golf course Nelson & Haworth Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Experience the 36-hole complex at Tan Son Nhat Golf Course, Nelson & Haworth’s immaculately conditioned urban parkland track featuring sweeping water hazards and expansive greens.

Spend your final evening in Saigon exploring District 1's world-class dining, craft cocktail bars, and lively nightlife.

itinerary.title: Coastal Drive to Ho Tram & Grand Ho Tram Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Coastal Transition
itinerary.imageCaption: The Grand Ho Tram Strip — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Grand Ho Tram Strip luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel via private executive coach south-east from Saigon to the pristine coastline of Ho Tram. Check in to your ocean-view room at The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram, situated directly beside Greg Norman's masterpiece.

Spend the afternoon on the beach or by the resort pools before dinner overlooking the East Sea.

itinerary.title: Greg Norman’s True Coastal Dunes Masterpiece: The Bluffs
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Pure Coastal Dunes Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram — Greg Norman (Par 71, 7,207 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram championship golf course Greg Norman Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram, Greg Norman’s World Top 100 links course routed through towering coastal sand dunes up to 50 meters above the sea. Wind is an ever-present factor as you navigate dramatic elevation changes, firm turf, and panoramic ocean vistas.

Celebrate an unforgettable round on the clubhouse terrace, followed by relaxation at the resort's luxury spa.

itinerary.title: The Bluffs Ho Tram Replay & Farewell Beach Barbecue
itinerary.subtitle: Round 4: Championship Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram — Greg Norman (Par 71, 7,207 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram championship golf course Greg Norman Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on The Bluffs for a second round, armed with knowledge of the prevailing winds and dramatic green undulations.

Gather for a tour-ending seafood feast on the beachfront, celebrating a magnificent week of southern Vietnam golf.

itinerary.title: Private Chauffeur Return to Tan Son Nhat Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: The Grand Ho Tram Strip — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Grand Ho Tram Strip luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast overlooking the ocean before packing your golf equipment.

Your private executive coach returns your party directly to Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City for your onward flight.

faqs.question: How windy is The Bluffs Ho Tram?
faqs.answer: As a true coastal dunes layout, afternoon winds regularly reach 15-25 knots, making morning tee times ideal for scoring.
